description: varibank with a second, TIME-VARYING PARTIALS score: the moving pitch-bands additionally carry a spectrum of (possibly fractional) partials whose numbers and amplitudes evolve over time. Pinned to submode 1 (Hz; submode 2 = MIDI). The fdata file has two '#'-separated sections: first varibank-style lines 'time pitch1 amp1 [pitch2 amp2 ...]' (equal pair counts, ascending times), then a line starting '#', then partials lines 'time partialno1 amp1 [partialno2 amp2 ...]' (partial numbers may be fractional, e.g. 3.5 for inharmonic timbres). BOTH sections' first time MUST be zero - refusals verbatim: 'FIRST TIME VALUE FOR PITCHES MUST BE ZERO' (a 0.5-start pitch section, which plain varibank accepts, is refused here) and 'FAILED TO GET SECOND SET OF DATA (PARTIALS INFORMATION) AFTER HASH SIGN' (missing # block). Output = indur + tail exactly with the family's undocumented 1.0 s tail default (pinned). Q time-variable (brk verified against both endpoints); gain refuses brks. Undocumented -n normalize switch (banner lists only -d; source vflag[1] -> do_norm): runs the level-assessment pre-pass, verified live (RMS 0.0067 -> 0.146). Deterministic; mono and stereo accepted; no vintage-hang exposure (varybank slots exist).
musical_use: Where varibank moves plain resonant bands, varibank2 moves TIMBRES: each band is a little additive spectrum whose partial recipe is itself automated. Fractional partial numbers (2.76, 3.5) build bell/gong inharmonicity that plain harmonic stacks (varibank -h) cannot; morph the partials block over time to make a band's character mutate - odd-partial 'clarinet' opening into a dense bell cloud - while the pitch block glides the fundamentals. Sound-design sweet spots: drawn formant glides with vowel-like interior colour, tuned-percussion resonance imposed on noise or breath, slow spectral 'lighting changes' on sustained drones. Both scores must start at t=0; keep partial counts modest (bands x partials sets the filter count and the render cost). High Q rings the recipe pure; -n rescues the level afterwards.

fdata.description: REQUIRED text file (write_data_file()): varibank-style pitch lines (first time 0.0), then '#', then partials lines 'time partialno amp ...' (first time 0.0; fractional partial numbers legal). Refusals verbatim in the entry description. ';' comments legal. Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

q.description: Filter tightness (family range 0.001-10000). Time-variable and VERIFIED: a 20->500 breakpoint rendered and differs from both scalar-endpoint renders.

gain.description: Overall gain (family range). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 2 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.' - family numbering).

tail.description: Ring-out appended after the input; output = indur + tail sample-exact (verified 1 s/2 s inputs, -t2). Undocumented default 1.0 s, pinned explicitly; family tail-0 bug assumed, curated min 0.01.

normalize.description: UNDOCUMENTED (banner lists only -d; source filters0.c do_norm via vflag[1]): level-assessment pre-pass plus gain rescale, verified live (RMS 0.0067 -> 0.146; 'INFO: Assessing input level.' printed). Roughly triples render time.

examples.description: Gliding two-band spectrum whose partial recipe morphs from near-harmonic to inharmonic.
examples.expected_use:
First write_data_file('vb2_morph.txt', '0.0  300 1.0  1200 0.5
1.5  600 1.0  900 0.8
#
0.0  1 1.0  2 0.5
1.5  1 1.0  3.5 0.8'). Fundamentals glide while partial 2 morphs to inharmonic 3.5; output = indur + 1.

known_issues: BOTH data sections must start at time 0.0 ('FIRST TIME VALUE FOR PITCHES MUST BE ZERO' verbatim) - stricter than plain varibank, which accepts a late first time. Missing '#' partials block: 'FAILED TO GET SECOND SET OF DATA (PARTIALS INFORMATION) AFTER HASH SIGN'.
UNDOCUMENTED -n normalize switch (source vflag[1] -> do_norm; banner lists only -d). Varybank internal-param slots cover the pre-pass write - no P5-1 vintage hang; version_sensitive false.
Undocumented tail default 1.0 s re-verified sample-exact; entry pins -t explicitly. tail 0 not probed - family bug assumed, curated min 0.01.
Only Q accepts breakpoint files (verified against both endpoints); gain refuses as parameter 2.
Unlike varibank there are NO -h/-r harmonic switches here - the partials block IS the harmonic mechanism. Submode 2 (MIDI) same argv - separate triple, not curated.
